data_description.url: The direct HTTP or HTTPS address, such as http://vacuula.local:8050 for Vacuula 1.1. Older installations may use port 80 or a custom app port. Omit /web and ingress paths.

map_promotion_required.message: The last floorplan or boundary upload was not confirmed. The robot may still use old zones or have no active floorplan. Promote it with the Vacuula map action to confirm recovery, or demote it with that action to continue without it. Explicit whole-home cleaning remains available.

map_promotion_required.title: Floorplan upload not confirmed for {robot}
map_promotion_required.description:
The last floorplan or boundary change for {robot} (map `{map_id}`) was not confirmed. The robot may still use old zones or have no active floorplan.

If an HTTP request was interrupted, Vacuula may still be processing it. Further map changes stay blocked until the Vacuula server restarts. Restarting Home Assistant alone does not stop those handlers. The integration detects a changed Vacuula process when possible. If its identity is unavailable, use `confirm_server_restarted: true` only after actually restarting Vacuula.

Then run `vacuula.map_action` with this map ID and `action: promote` to confirm the upload, or `action: demote` to continue without the floorplan. A recognized completed Vacuula error does not require the extra restart. After a boundary edit, an unchanged promoted flag alone does not confirm the edited zones reached the robot.

Automatic and mapped starts and mapped schedule changes from Home Assistant remain blocked until recovery is confirmed. Explicit whole-home cleaning remains available, and mapped events can still be turned off. Existing schedules and controls outside Home Assistant are not blocked. Robot commands are never retried automatically.

clean.name: Clean a map or zone
clean.description: Start a cleaning run with explicit settings. Automatically uses an active saved map while docked, otherwise starts whole-home cleaning without no-go boundaries. Choose Map to require mapped cleaning. Generation 3 supports one zone per action.

cleaning_type.name: Cleaning type
cleaning_type.description: Auto uses an active map while docked and falls back to whole-home cleaning otherwise. Map requires a usable map and docked robot. Whole home ignores maps and no-go boundaries. An explicit map ID takes precedence over Auto or Map.

zone_ids.name: Zone IDs
zone_ids.description: Boundary IDs from the selected map. Leave empty to clean the whole map.

set_schedule.name: Replace schedule
set_schedule.description: Replace all Generation 3 schedule events. Local input uses Home Assistant's timezone. Vacuula 1.1 uses the robot's local clock; 1.0 uses UTC. Conversion uses current timezone offsets. This does not enable the schedule. An empty list removes all events.

events.name: Events
events.description: List of mode (1 eco, 2 turbo), day (0 Sunday to 6 Saturday), startTime (HH:MM), and optional boundaryId. A returned boundary object must contain its id and is converted to boundaryId. Missing or conflicting zone IDs are rejected. Times and weekdays use the selected time basis.

time_basis.name: Time basis
time_basis.description: Local uses Home Assistant's timezone. UTC uses UTC times. Robot preserves raw clock slots from get_data on every supported server version. Times are converted using current offsets; rewrite converted schedules after offset changes.

update_schedule_event.name: Add or update schedule event
update_schedule_event.description: Add or update a Generation 4 schedule event. With an existing event ID, only supplied fields change and all other settings and zones are preserved. New events require enabled, days and time and default to eco, normal navigation and the promoted floorplan with no-go protection when available. Times use the robot's configured timezone.

event_id.name: Existing event ID
event_id.description: Omit to create an event. Supply an existing ID to update selected fields from the robot's current event.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Required for a new event. Omit to preserve an existing value.

days.name: Days
days.description: Required for a new event. Omit to preserve an existing value.

time.name: Start time (HH:MM)
time.description: Required for a new event. Omit to preserve an existing value.

cleaning_type.name: Cleaning type
cleaning_type.description: Auto uses the promoted floorplan when available; for an existing event that targets a map it is rejected while no floorplan is promoted. Map requires one. Whole home removes zones and ignores no-go boundaries. Omit to preserve an existing target. The robot's current dock state does not affect future events.

zone_ids.name: Zone IDs
zone_ids.description: Omit to preserve an existing zone selection. When changing to another floorplan, supply its zone IDs or an empty list to clean that whole floorplan.

set_boundaries.name: Replace map boundaries
set_boundaries.description: Replace the complete boundary list on a map. An empty list removes all boundaries. Boundaries read with get_data can be written back unchanged; a missing Generation 3 relevancy is computed from the vertices. An active Generation 4 floorplan is promoted again to send the changes to the robot, and the schedule is re-read because the firmware may disable affected events. A failed promotion may leave no active floorplan; Automatic and mapped actions stay blocked until the floorplan is promoted again or demoted with the map action. Inactive maps stay inactive. Use get_data to read the current boundaries first.

rename_robot.name: Rename robot
rename_robot.description: Change the robot's name in Vacuula.

update_map.name: Update map
update_map.description: Change a map's name and Generation 3 enabled setting.

map_action.name: Manage floorplan
map_action.description: Promote, include, exclude or demote a Generation 4 map. Demote removes its active floorplan status. As in the Vacuula app, only a map marked with use can be promoted, and the active floorplan must be demoted before unuse.

confirm_server_restarted.name: Confirm Vacuula was restarted
confirm_server_restarted.description: Enable only after restarting the Vacuula server to end unknown map requests, when its restart cannot be detected automatically. This clears the request fence; promote or demote must still succeed to resolve recovery.

get_data.name: Read robot data
get_data.description: Return structured robot data, maps, run history or boundaries for use in scripts. Generation 3 schedule times are raw robot clock slots: UTC on Vacuula 1.0 and local on 1.1. Use the Robot time basis to write them back. Requires a response variable.

factory_reset.name: Factory reset
factory_reset.description: Erase Generation 4 robot settings. The robot may need provisioning again. This action requires explicit confirmation.
